//2: your mail. Credentials are NEVER here: GMAIL_ADDRESS + GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD come from
//3: the environment (seeded by the gitignored config/secrets.json). With no key Herald
//4: renders as 'not configured' and every job no-ops.
//5: Anything retuned at runtime lands in config/herald.local.json (gitignored).
//to: Where mail goes. Empty = the account's own address, which is the self-send path
//to2: that is allowed to send unattended. Any other address is approval-gated.
//to3: Tip: set a +tag form of your own address (you+orion@gmail.com). It still counts as
//to4: you, and it gives Gmail a filter target — the only reliable way to mark these
//to5: important, label them, and keep them out of Promotions.
//from2: Herald send from its own free Google account. Without them it sends from your own
//from3: address to your own address, and Gmail files that as mail you sent yourself —
//from4: your avatar, 'me' as the sender, and no importance signal it can learn from.
//from5: Gmail rewrites a From header that isn't the authenticated account, so a second
//from6: account is the only thing that actually changes this.
//subject: Every subject is '<prefix> — <what happened> · <date>'. Fixed prefix so it is
//subject2: recognisable and filterable; the tail says whether it needs opening.
//priority: Letters that claim high priority. Honoured by most desktop clients; Gmail's
//priority2: importance markers are learned per-user and cannot be asserted by a sender.
//caps: Herald must never become noise: a hard ceiling per day, and digests stay out of
//caps2: quiet hours. Alerts ignore quiet hours — a failure at 02:00 is worth knowing.
//prose: true = deepseek-v4-flash writes the letter around the figures. Every number is
//prose2: still rendered deterministically; the model only writes prose. If it is
//prose3: unavailable the mail still goes out, template-only.
